text: The model flagged this applicant as high‑risk because the strongest signals point to a high likelihood of default. Their revolving‑credit utilization is about 77 % of the available limit, and this alone adds the largest positive contribution (+0.94) to the default probability, indicating they are heavily using their credit. In addition, the applicant has 14 open credit lines and loans; having many active accounts adds another positive boost (+0.22) to the risk score, suggesting a complex credit picture that can be harder to manage. Their monthly income of $13,333 does pull the risk down slightly (‑0.16), but the impact is modest and does not offset the strong negative signals from utilization and the number of open accounts.
